name: Dompe
description: Dompe is a popular Philippine survival card game, also known as Knock Poker. It combines poker hand rankings with draw-and-discard mechanics. Players aim to build the best five-card hand and 'knock' (call Dompe) before their opponents, or win instantly with specific six-card combinations.

content.text: Dompe is a popular Philippine survival card game, also known as Knock Poker. It combines poker hand rankings with draw-and-discard mechanics. Players aim to build the best five-card hand and 'knock' (call Dompe) before their opponents, or win instantly with specific six-card combinations.
Originating in the Philippines, Dompe is a localized version of Knock Poker. It has been a staple social game in Philippine households and community centers for decades.
2 to 5 players using one deck. Additional decks can be added for more players.
Standard 52-card deck plus one Joker (53 tiles).
One deck of cards, betting chips (one chip ante per player).
5 cards dealt to each player, one at a time, in an anti-clockwise direction.
